Notes_and_Tips: Since weight gain is the goal, avoid skipping meals.
Start meals with protein to support lean muscle gain.
Keep fried foods limited even if weight gain is desired.
For stress or boredom eating, stick to planned meals and snacks.
Yoga supports flexibility; add regular meals for better strength and recovery.
Focus on steady progress and energy rather than rapid weight changes.
